import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int Mod = 1000000007;
    static long n;
    static int K, sum, now, a[] = new int[110], m;
    static Matrix ans, s[][] = new Matrix[75][35], pre[][] = new Matrix[75][35], suf[][] = new Matrix[75][35];

    static class Matrix {
        int v[][] = new int[35][35];

        Matrix() {
            for (int i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                    v[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix a) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix();
            for (int k = 0; k <= K; k++) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
                    if (v[i][k] != 0) {
                        for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                            if (a.v[k][j] != 0) {
                                long temp = (1L * v[i][k] * a.v[k][j] + res.v[i][j]) % Mod;
                                res.v[i][j] = (int) temp;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static void ADD(int[] x, int y, int m) {
        x[0] += y;
        if (x[0] >= m) x[0] -= m;
    }

    static void work(long n) {
        long tmp = n;
        m = 0;
        while (tmp != 0) {
            a[++m] = (int) (tmp % K);
            tmp /= K;
        }
        // reverse a[1..m]
        for (int i = 1; i <= m / 2; i++) {
            int temp = a[i];
            a[i] = a[m - i + 1];
            a[m - i + 1] = temp;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextInt();
        // n++;
        work(n);

        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                s[0][i] = new Matrix();
                s[0][i].v[j][j] = 1;
                s[0][i].v[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                pre[i - 1][j] = new Matrix();
                pre[i - 1][j].v = s[i - 1][0].v.clone();
            }
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                pre[i - 1][j] = pre[i - 1][j - 1].multiply(s[i - 1][j]);
            }
            for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                suf[i - 1][j] = new Matrix();
                suf[i - 1][j].v = s[i - 1][j].v.clone();
                suf[i - 1][j] = suf[i - 1][j].multiply(suf[i - 1][j + 1]);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                if (j != 0) {
                    s[i][j] = suf[i - 1][j].multiply(pre[i - 1][j - 1]);
                } else {
                    s[i][j] = suf[i - 1][j];
                }
            }
        }

        ans = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                ans.v[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }

        now = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            if (a[i] != 0) {
                if (now + a[i] - 1 >= K) {
                    for (int j = now; j < K; j++) {
                        ans = ans.multiply(s[m - i][j]);
                    }
                    for (int j = 0; j <= (now + a[i] - 1) - K; j++) {
                        ans = ans.multiply(s[m - i][j]);
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int j = now; j <= now + a[i] - 1; j++) {
                        ans = ans.multiply(s[m - i][j]);
                    }
                }
                ADD(new int[]{now}, a[i], K);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            ADD(new int[]{sum}, ans.v[i][K], Mod);
        }
        System.out.println(sum);
        sc.close();
    }
}
